chosen_config.description: Hybrid search (k=5, alpha=0.65) combining dense vectors with exact lexical matching and section filter.

chosen_settings.justification: The 'hybrid_filtered_weighted' configuration achieved the highest overall performance with a Composite Score of 100.0/100. Compared to the baseline vector search (baseline_k3), it delivered a Top-1 Hit Rate of 100.0% (+33.3%), an MRR of 1.0000 (+0.2778), and 100% Domain Precision (+5.6%). By combining section metadata filtering with lexical keyword and clause boosting (hybrid alpha=0.65), it eliminates cross-domain distractions (such as steel buckling in timber queries) while ensuring exact regulatory clauses (e.g. Clause 2.18) are indexed directly at Rank 1.
